answer: Sybil resistance comes from requiring each identity to complete a Wesolowski VDF: a prescribed chain of modular squarings, each dependent on the previous result. GPUs may speed individual operations, but cannot parallelize that dependency chain to make one clone finish sooner. Additional clones require separate chains and incur the same sequential delay. A ferrous relic beside copper circuitry is only scenery; admission depends on elapsed work, while the resulting proof is efficient to verify.
